component.name: Task Manager
Gestionnaire des tâches
مدير المهام
component.summary: Monitor system resources, processes and services
Surveiller les ressources système, les processus et les services

description.p: Inspect CPU, memory, and other resource measurements. Inside Flatpak, the process list is limited to the application sandbox and host service management is unavailable.
Start CPU sampling when Task Manager opens and show the system-on-chip name when CPU identification is generic.
Task Manager is available on enzim Apps. The Flatpak shows resource measurements and processes inside its sandbox.
The storage view identifies temporary storage that uses memory. Performance charts pause their animations in the background.
